description:
**Friends Medicines Clinic** — *With us life gets better* — located in **Koro**, is hiring an **Enrolled Nurse** to join its team.

## About the clinic

Friends Medicines Clinic serves the Koro community as a busy outpatient facility where nursing is the heartbeat of patient experience — from the first vital sign recorded to wound care and health education at discharge. The team lives by its motto: *"With us life gets better."*

## The role

You will be the nurse patients meet first and remember most: triaging, treating and reassuring a steady flow of outpatients in a fast-paced clinic setting, working hand-in-hand with clinicians and pharmacy staff under one roof.

## Key responsibilities

- Provide quality nursing care to patients
- Take and record vital signs
- Administer medications and injections as prescribed
- Perform wound dressing and first aid
- Assist clinicians during examinations and procedures
- Provide health education to patients and families
- Maintain accurate patient records and reports
- Ensure infection prevention and safety standards

## Requirements

- Certificate or Diploma in Nursing (Enrolled Nurse level)
- Registered with the Uganda Nurses and Midwives Council with a valid practicing licence
- At least 2 years working experience in a busy clinic or health facility
- Good knowledge of nursing procedures and patient care
- Good communication and interpersonal skills
- Compassionate, honest and team-oriented

## How to apply

Call **0777 940 996** or **0764 000 691**, or email your application to **rwotomiopharmacy@gmail.com**.

> Note: Never pay money for a job opportunity or recruitment process.
